address: 70-81 Mortimer Street, Fitzrovia, London, W1W 7SJ, United Kingdom
bio: This extremely colourful, comfortable restaurant in the heart of Fitzrovia is modelled on the communal living ‘building societies’ of Bombay, and comes with striking posters, a relaxed ambience and an intimate basement bar. The menu is divided into ‘small’ and ‘big’ plates and sharing is encouraged. Dishes are confidently executed, easy to eat and full of fresh, regionally inspired flavours....
